name: flowsery
description: Ask how your websites are doing. See visitors, sessions, bounce rate, conversions and revenue, broken down by page, traffic source, campaign, location or device. Review the issues Flowsery found in recorded sessions, see how to reproduce them and mark them resolved. Look up one visitor's activity when you ask for it. You can also record goal completions in your analytics or delete them; this changes analytics data only.

interface.longDescription: Ask how your websites are doing. See visitors, sessions, bounce rate, conversions and revenue, broken down by page, traffic source, campaign, location or device. Review the issues Flowsery found in recorded sessions, see how to reproduce them and mark them resolved. Look up one visitor's activity when you ask for it. You can also record goal completions in your analytics or delete them; this changes analytics data only.
defaultPrompt: Show my website traffic this month
Where do my visitors come from?
Show the issues found on my website

positive.description: Summarize last month's traffic and revenue.
positive.prompt: How did flowsery.com do last month? I want visitors, bounce rate, revenue and conversion rate.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns last month's visitors, bounce rate, revenue and conversion rate for flowsery.com.

positive.description: List workspaces and the websites in each.
positive.prompt: List my Flowsery workspaces and the websites in each.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspaces this sign-in can reach, then the websites in each, such as flowsery.com, redreplier.com and adaptlypost.com in the AdaptlyPost workspace.

positive.prompt: Which websites sent the most visitors to flowsery.com last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sources that sent flowsery.com the most visitors last month, such as Google or Reddit, ranked by visitors.

positive.description: Show one issue and how to reproduce it.
positive.prompt: What's the top issue Flowsery found on flowsery.com, and how do I reproduce it?
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the top issue on flowsery.com and shows how often it happened, the affected sessions and the recorded reproduction steps. Steps that weren't recorded are not made up.

positive.prompt: Which pages on flowsery.com got the most visitors last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists flowsery.com's pages ranked by visitors for last month.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general analytics questions.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between sessions and users in web analytics.

negative.description: Do not trigger for websites the user doesn't track.
negative.prompt: How much monthly traffic does ahrefs.com get?

negative.description: Do not trigger for A/B testing.
negative.prompt: Set up an A/B test on my pricing page headline.

review.commerce_description: Flowsery does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes:
Initial release. Ask how your websites are doing and get answers from your Flowsery analytics.

- See visitors, sessions, bounce rate, conversions and revenue, broken down by page, traffic source, campaign, location or device.
- Review the issues Flowsery found in recorded sessions, see how to reproduce them and mark them resolved.
- See who is on your site right now, and look up one visitor's activity when you ask for it.
- Record goal completions in your analytics, or delete them. This changes analytics data only.
- Work in any Flowsery workspace you belong to.
